title: [review] project-LICHEN-n8c6: KEY_CHANGE detection test removed from test_link_layer
description: A test block in test_tx_queue_integration (around test_radio_false_preserves_packet_for_retry) verifying key-change detection (ReceiveError.KEY_CHANGE path at link_layer.py:570) was deleted. The test overwrote pinned_keys to simulate key-change scenario and asserted ReceiveError.KEY_CHANGE result. Replacement peer_ll2 LinkLayer instance was also removed. KEY_CHANGE code is still present in link_layer.py:570 and consumed by node.py:396 and kiss/bridge.py:340, but is now untested in the link layer test suite.
